## Motivation

`tc_piecewise` compiles the language-model forward with `torch.compile(fullgraph=True)`. Any graph break in this region aborts prefill CUDA graph capture.

The layer-boundary runtime path currently contains three Dynamo-incompatible operations:

1. Runtime carriers are constructed as `msgspec.Struct` instances inside the compiled region. Dynamo cannot trace their C-level `__new__`, and its `object.__new__(cls)` safety check rejects the construction.
2. Deprecated module-level group getters inspect `sys._getframe(1)` through a deprecation wrapper, which Dynamo cannot trace.
3. `is_musa()` imports `torchada` lazily. Calling it from a fullgraph-compiled region exposes an import operation to Dynamo and causes another graph break.

These issues were observed during MiniMax-M3 TP16 prefill CUDA graph capture, where boundary carriers are constructed and completed inside the compiled region.

```
  File "/ppusw/share/mayiling.myl/sglang/upstream_sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/layer_boundary/layout.py", line 182, in _batch_shards_over_cp
    if _gathers_over_attention_cp():
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/ppusw/share/mayiling.myl/sglang/upstream_sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/layer_boundary/layout.py", line 173, in _gathers_over_attention_cp
    return is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp() or is_mla_cp_enabled()
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/ppusw/share/mayiling.myl/sglang/upstream_sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa/utils.py", line 117, in is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp
    if is_hip() or is_musa():
                   ^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/opt/sglang/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch/_dynamo/polyfills/__init__.py", line 487, in getattr_and_trace
    return fn(*args[2:], **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/ppusw/share/mayiling.myl/sglang/upstream_sglang/python/sglang/srt/utils/common.py", line 226, in is_musa
    import torchada  # noqa: F401

Set TORCHDYNAMO_VERBOSE=1 for the internal stack trace (please do this especially if you're reporting a bug to PyTorch). For even more developer context, set TORCH_LOGS="+dynamo"

```

## Modifications

- Convert runtime boundary carriers from `msgspec.Struct` to dataclasses so Dynamo can trace their construction:
  - Use frozen dataclasses for immutable carriers.
  - Keep `Contribution` mutable because `complete()` updates its state.
  - Keep plan-time-only containers on `msgspec.Struct`.
- Document why carriers constructed inside the compiled region must retain a standard Python `__new__`.
- Bypass the deprecation wrapper's `sys._getframe` caller inspection when `torch.compiler.is_compiling()` is true. Eager callers retain the existing one-time `DeprecationWarning`.
- Resolve MUSA availability at module load time so `is_musa()` no longer performs an import inside a compiled region.
- Add focused Dynamo regression tests covering:
  - Construction and completion of layer-boundary carriers under `torch.compile(fullgraph=True)`.
  - The dataclass construction contract required by Dynamo.
  - Deprecation-wrapper behavior in compiled and eager execution.

Local verification:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python3 -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layer_boundary/test_residual_stream.py \
  test/registered/unit/distributed/test_parallel_state.py
```

Result: 54 passed and 8 subtests passed. All newly added Dynamo regression tests passed. Two existing parallel-group tests failed during `destroy_model_parallel()` cleanup because `uvicorn` is not installed in the local environment.

Also verified:

- `python3 -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/utils/common.py`
- Import and non-MUSA smoke test for `is_musa()`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A. This PR fixes Dynamo tracing and CUDA graph capture without changing the model's numerical algorithm or output semantics.

MiniMax-M3 TP16 end-to-end validation was not run in the local environment.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A. This PR does not introduce a performance optimization or change the eager runtime algorithm. Its purpose is to allow fullgraph compilation and prefill CUDA graph capture to complete without Dynamo graph breaks.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Added inline documentation for the Dynamo-specific carrier and deprecation-wrapper constraints; no user-facing documentation change is required.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). N/A as explained above.
